description.en: Enables or disables frustum/visibility culling for a character, forcing it to always be considered for rendering when disabled (useful for characters that must stay visible even when the engine would normally cull them, e.g. off-screen cutscene actors).
False to force the character to always render regardless of visibility culling.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Force a character to keep rendering even when it would normally be culled
CMND_SET_CHARA_CULLING(hKudouL, false);
